snippet.title: Emma Watson Speech Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2 Premiere London
snippet.description:
See Emma Watson's face during her emotional speech at the Harry Potter Premiere. On YouTube broadcast she had her back to the camera. With this different camera angle you can see her facial expression (apart from when one of the Davids gets in the way). She laughs and cries at the same time. See how she tears up and so does JK Rowling, they cry nice together. Emma Watson is also clearly emotional leaving the square nearly crying at the end of this video. 

This video is part of the Magical premiere videos. 
See also the premiere playlist:
http://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL79339C90610A8D5D
And a 2 minute compilation video:
http://youtu.be/x46b8Jwke2k
And a 16 minute full-lenght/ omnibus video:
http://youtu.be/LHABlO2CKLM
And the HP7 Part 1 Premiere: 
http://youtu.be/eN-9zMrqkCo 

Emma Watson on the red carpet of Harry Potter 7 Part 2 World Premiere on 7 July in Trafalgar Square in London, England, UK.  Go and see Hermione Granger, Harry Potter and Ron Weasley in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2 released 15 July 2011 by Warner Brothers.
It all ends here... or does it?

Video footage shot in HD 720p on a Panasonic TM700. Edited in Final Cut Pro X. Music created in GarageBand using a loop titled "Dogma".

This video upload contains English transcribed closed captioning (CC) subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing (SDH).

But it is Harry Potter who may be called upon to make the ultimate sacrifice as he draws closer to the cinematic showdown with Lord Voldemort.

snippet.title: Emma Watson reveals half-naked kiss in Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows part 2 was boring
snippet.description:
The Hermione Granger actress made the comments as she joined other cast and crew at a press conference to mark the imminent release of Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows Part 2, 
  the eighth and final instalment in the wizarding saga.
